deathCause.summary: Died after being stabbed during prayer in Medina
deathCause.summaryCn: 在麦地那礼拜时遇刺，后因伤去世
deathCause.detail: He was stabbed while leading prayers and died several days later from his wounds.
deathCause.detailCn: 他在领礼时遭刺杀，数日后因伤势去世。

events.label: Converted to Islam
events.note: Traditional accounts date his conversion before the Hijra; the exact year is uncertain.

events.label: Migrated from Mecca to Medina
events.note: He joined the Medinan community during the Hijra.

events.label: Succeeded Abū Bakr as caliph
events.labelCn: 继阿布·伯克尔之后出任哈里发
events.note: Abū Bakr nominated ʿUmar before his death.

events.label: Muslim forces defeated the Byzantines at Yarmouk
events.labelCn: 穆斯林军队在雅尔穆克击败拜占庭军
events.note: The victory opened Syria to Rashidun rule.

events.label: Rashidun forces defeated the Sasanian army at al-Qādisiyyah
events.labelCn: 正统哈里发军队在卡迪西亚击败萨珊军
events.note: The battle was decisive in the conquest of Iraq.

events.label: Accepted Jerusalem’s surrender
events.note: Later accounts place ʿUmar’s visit after the city’s surrender.

events.label: Established the Hijri calendar for official administration
events.labelCn: 为官方行政确立希吉拉纪年
events.note: The calendar was counted from the Hijra of 622.

events.label: Authorized the conquest of Egypt
events.note: ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ’s campaign brought Egypt under Rashidun authority by 642.

events.label: Was stabbed while leading prayer in Medina
events.labelCn: 在麦地那领礼时遭刺杀
events.note: He died several days later from the wounds.

events.label: Died from his wounds
events.note: His council selected ʿUthmān as the next caliph.

sourceNote: Hugh N. Kennedy, The Prophet and the Age of the Caliphates; Fred M. Donner, The Early Islamic Conquests; Wikipedia used as a chronology index.
notes:
Second caliph of the Rashidun period. His reign oversaw a rapid expansion of the polity into Byzantine and Sasanian territories.

Confidence / caveats: conventional birth year and several exact campaign dates are approximate; the broad succession and conquests are secure.
